These relationships are corroborated by DharmaNexus, which aligns the text extensively with Sanskrit fragments of the *Mahāvadānasūtra*, the *Saṅghabhedavastu*, the *Lalitavistara*, the Chinese *Dīrgha-āgama* (T 1), and Tibetan translations such as the *Abhiniṣkramaṇa-sūtra* and *Vinayavastu* [DharmaNexus].
